<translate>
<!--T:6-->
'''Guldo''' is a member of the '''Ginyu Force''', Frieza's elite squad. In [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza's Invasion|Frieza's Invasion]], the raid of [[Special:MyLanguage/Namek|Planet Namek]], he arrives in the final wave with the rest of the squad. He has the least health of the five.
</translate>

<translate>
== In raids == <!--T:7-->

<!--T:8-->
The whole Ginyu Force is the boss group of wave 5: Guldo, [[Special:MyLanguage/Recoome|Recoome]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Burter|Burter]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Jeice|Jeice]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Ginyu|Ginyu]], escorted by 15 [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza Soldier|Frieza Soldiers]]. The five stay dormant until the soldiers are dead, but attacking one wakes it up early. Like every raid boss, they glow red.

<!--T:9-->
In the raid Guldo has 6,000 health, 55 melee damage and 60 ki damage, and fights on the [[Special:MyLanguage/Sagas#Enemy AI tiers|Smart]] AI tier, like Recoome; the other three are Elite. These are the defaults, before the story difficulty multiplier of the player who started the raid (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Raids#Difficulty|Raids]]); the number of participants doesn't change them.
</translate>

<translate>
== Behavior and abilities == <!--T:10-->

<!--T:11-->
* '''Flight:''' Guldo flies and follows you into the air.
* '''Ki Blast:''' green ki blasts.
* '''Dodging:''' he can step back out of the way of your hits.
</translate>

<translate>
== Drops == <!--T:12-->

<!--T:13-->
Guldo drops nothing. Clearing the raid rewards everyone still fighting (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza's Invasion#Rewards|Frieza's Invasion]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:14-->

<!--T:15-->
In the [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza Saga|Frieza Saga]], the quest '''Ginyu Force: Guldo''' has you defeat him on Namek's Ajissa Plains. After the saga quest '''Captain Ginyu''', the side quest '''Ginyu Force Stragglers''' sends him and [[Special:MyLanguage/Recoome|Recoome]] after you again on Namek (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Sidequests|Sidequests]]).
</translate>
